# Cart and Edit-Lock Requirements Checklist: Shared Kitchen Cart with People, Meals, Scale Factor and Single-Editor Locks

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for the cart rules and the single-editor locks (cart and recipe) are complete, clear and consistent before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [tasks.md](../tasks.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Does the spec state how a member deliberately starts editing the cart? FR-017 says the lock is taken on the "first cart change", but contracts/cart-ui.md and research R7 add an explicit Edit button. [Conflict, Spec §FR-017]

Edit button is the start of the lock

- [x] CHK002 - Is it specified that a member who ticks "Add to cart" on a card or the detail page becomes the cart's editor, and how they are told they now hold the cart for everyone else? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §US1]

A toast message shows a loading spinner that says cart locked, until the recipe is added, then the spinner turns into a check mark and the toast message is "Done". If the cart is locked before the recipe is added, the toast message is "Somebody is currently updating the cart"

- [x] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for what happens when an abandoned lock lasts as long as the session (sessions last 30 days today)? Is that intended, or is an idle limit or a way to take over the lock needed? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK004 - Does the spec say whether the lock holder may Delete the recipe they are editing, and what happens to their open edit? [Gap, Spec §US4, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK005 - Is it defined what a person sees when their own other device holds the lock? FR-021 treats it as another editor, but the notice would name the person themselves. [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for an unsaved cart draft when the kitchen is archived, and again when it is unarchived? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK007 - Is it stated that a lock voided by lost access stays void if access comes back (member re-added, kitchen unarchived) during the same session, rather than coming back with its old draft? [Gap, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK008 - Does the spec say what the editor is told when their lock ends while they are away (session ended elsewhere, access lost), and whether their on-screen recipe edits are kept for copying? [Gap, Spec §FR-020, Spec §US4]
- [x] CHK009 - Are requirements defined for which notebook name and title a cart entry shows after its kitchen notebook or recipe is renamed? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 - Is the rounding rule for "at most 2 decimals" named in the spec (half-up, in research R9), so 0.005 and 2/3 have one correct display? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK011 - Is "member count" defined: all members whatever their role, counted when the cart is read? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK012 - Is "a member saves a people number" clear when a member saves a draft without touching People? Does saving the default value turn off "follow members"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK013 - Is "session ends" defined (sign-out, expiry, password reset signing out everywhere) so that each case has a clear outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK014 - Is "loses access" listed as specific events (leaving or removal from the kitchen or notebook, archive, account deletion)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the wording of the editor notice set for both languages, including when the editor's alias is unknown? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-024]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 - Does the people default (member count) agree with PRD J4 ("default 2"), or is the PRD update tracked? [Conflict, Spec §Clarifications, Tasks T046]
- [x] CHK017 - Do FR-023 and spec 027 FR-011 agree on which check comes first for a recipe edit, and is spec 027 marked as amended? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK018 - Are the cart write actions FR-017/FR-019 lock (add, remove, people, meals, clear) the same list in US1, US3 and the edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §US1, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK019 - Is "save unlocks" stated the same way for the cart (US3.3) and for recipes (US4.3), including that others then edit the new version? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK020 - Are US1 scenario 1 ("appears in the kitchen's cart") and FR-018 (a draft until saved) consistent about when an added recipe is visible to other members? [Conflict, Spec §US1, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK021 - Does FR-022 (deletes are not blocked by locks) agree with FR-019 (Delete unavailable while someone else edits) for a recipe deleted along with its notebook? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-022]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK022 - Can SC-004 "open for edits within the next open or refresh" be measured without knowing how long the session has left? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK023 - Do the success criteria cover the race in which two members try to start editing at the same moment? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK024 - Is SC-008 (100 recipes within 1 s) tied to a stated environment and starting state (cold or warm, dev stack)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK025 - Does a scenario cover FR-013's rule that a discarded draft never raises the add count? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Spec §US5]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK026 - Are requirements written for a draft that refers to a recipe moved out of the kitchen? Recipes only move by copying today, so is this case explicitly ruled out? [Edge Case, Assumption]
- [x] CHK027 - Are there requirements for the dropped-recipe message when several drafted recipes are deleted, and for when the editor sees it (on view or on save)? [Clarity, Spec §US5 scenario 2]
- [x] CHK028 - Is the behaviour of a cart draft defined when the member count changes while people still follows the members? Does the draft follow too? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK029 - Is the outcome defined when a recipe's base servings change while it sits in someone's unsaved cart draft? [Edge Case, Spec §US2 scenario 5]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK030 - Are accessibility requirements set for the editor notice, the disabled controls and the people and meals fields (keyboard use, screen-reader announcement)? [Gap]
- [x] CHK031 - Are privacy limits stated for the notice (only people who can already see the item learn who is editing it)? [Coverage, Plan §Constitution 4]
- [x] CHK032 - Is phone-width layout required for the Cart page and the notices? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK033 - Is the dependency on session lifetime (owned by the unchanged auth layer) and the owner's approval of `require_session_ref` recorded in the spec, not only in plan and research? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK034 - Is the assumption "no live push; others see changes on open or refresh" in line with the locking experience? Is refresh on focus a requirement or a design choice? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Tasks T034]
- [x] CHK035 - Is it stated how the lock rules apply to MCP cart and recipe writes later (S-032), which have no browser session? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
